knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson requires traceability (identifier, date, zone, author and criterion) and forbids using photographs alone as proof of compliance. Editing and identifying people are not allowed.
Staged training images must be clearly labelled so they cannot be mistaken for actual customer work.
The choose legitimate evidence section lists work orders, time-stamped inspection records, approved photographs and corrective action logs.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes procedure step 1: Select evidence that shows a specific course outcome: work orders, time-stamped inspection records, approved photographs and corrective action logs.
Learner completes procedure step 2: Obtain the required consent before photographing, and keep faces, documents, addresses, access codes and personal possessions out of frame.
Learner completes procedure step 3: Give each record a site or simulated site identifier, date, zone, author and inspection criterion.
Learner completes procedure step 4: Label staged training images clearly so they cannot be mistaken for customer work.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Select evidence that shows a specific course outcome: work orders, time-stamped inspection records, approved photographs and corrective action logs.
Record of procedure step 2: Obtain the required consent before photographing, and keep faces, documents, addresses, access codes and personal possessions out of frame.
Record of procedure step 3: Give each record a site or simulated site identifier, date, zone, author and inspection criterion.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 8 is not done: Do not claim accreditation, laboratory testing or regulatory compliance from photographs alone.
